services.name: Bell Tent Rental
services.desc: "Rent The Tent"-The Bell Tent is great for those who have larger groups....the tent will hold 6-8 sleeping bags comfortably. Just let us know where you want the tent and we will set it up and pick up! You can choose a special location, but don't forget about the fun of camping in your own backyard. The bell tent is so cool, and great for special occasions. Whether it be for camping birthday parties, bride or groom holding area for weddings, or a dinner party with a cocktail area... the tent will be the perfect addition to make your occasion special! We will deliver the tent to your Great for parties!

services.name: Lea Island Nature Adventure
services.desc: An amazing day-trip to our "nature lovers" PARADISE! Lea Island is a four-mile uninhabited island located between Figure Eight and Topsail Islands. The special island has been designated as one of 96 Important Bird Areas in North Carolina and is a refuge for many types of shorebirds and waterbirds, as well as nesting loggerhead sea turtles. Lea Island is known by the locals as "the place to go" for dropping anchor and combing the white sand beaches for shells, including sand dollars and whelks. Nature at it's finest, and just a 25 minute boat ride from Wrightsville Beach...Lea Island is 3 Hours • $115 per person • Public Shared Experience

services.name: Half-Day Private Boat Charter
services.desc: Private island-hopping cruise around Wrightsville Beach with swimming, sandbars, dolphin watching, and beautiful barrier islands. Customer Favorite! The sweet spot for a unforgettable boat day. • 3 Hours

services.name: 2-Hour Scenic Coastal Cruise
services.desc: Half Day Private Charters - With a Private Boat Charter, you get a completely private boating trip with one of our USCG licensed captains, who are knowledgeable in our local "hot spots", diverse wildlife and local history. Relax and enjoy your surroundings while one of our captains chauffeurs you and your group to one of the favorite local paradises that can only be accessed by boat, like Masonboro Island, Mason's Inlet or Lee Island. IT'S YOUR CRUISE SO YOU CHOOSE...You’ll have plenty of activity options to choose from, including island hopping, backwater boating, dolphin watching, The perfect quick escape to relax and enjoy the scenic barrier islands near Wrightsville Beach.

services.name: 4-Hour Private Boat Charter: Islands & Sandbars
services.desc: Four-hour all-inclusive private boat cruise for island hopping, beach time, wildlife viewing and relaxing with provided gear and captain. More time, more extras, and the ultimate day on the water.

services.desc: Epic Adventures is a camp for young kids who love nature and water activities that involve boating, surfing and paddle boarding. Ages: 9 - 14 (8 kids max) • WEEKLY CAMPS

services.name: Steam Pot Seafood Boil Experience
services.desc: Cruise over to one of our favorite islands to cook up a low country boil steam pot fromTopsail Steamer out of Wrightsville Beach! Relax on the island and take in the beautiful scenery while your captain cooks your steam pot to perfection! We provide the steam pot burner for cooking and a table for the food. YOUR CAPTAIN COOKS THE FOOD! Most of our customers prefer to stand around the table to eat, but feel free to bring plates if you prefer to make a plate and eat in your beach chair! Great for families, couples, or party groups! Please Note Steam Pot sold separately, delivered to our boat, Fun Experience! • 🦐 Island seafood boil • 3 Hours

services.name: Masonboro Island Adventure
services.desc: Board our 24ft. Carolina Skiff and come with us to see why everyone loves beautiful Masonboro Island…One of the largest undisturbed barrier islands along the southern part of the NC coast. As we cruise on a 15-20 minute boat ride over to the island, the captain will discuss and point out native wildlife, local history, and the diverse eco-systems surrounding our coastline. Once you arrive on the island, you will have about an hour to explore the beach, and comb the island for shells. After exploring the island you will board the boat and enjoy the scenic views as we make our way back to 2 hours • All Ages Welcome • Public Shared Experience • (call for group rates of 8 or more)

services.name: Private Surf Charter
services.desc: Surf Charters For you surfers and paddle surfers looking for some surf stoke that can only be found by boat! Then chill out on deck in the sun or shade after your session with a cold beverage! Whatever conditions are thrown at us...we’ve got you covered! services.name: Salt Marsh Paddleboarding Tour
services.desc: Explore the natural salt marshes and uninhabited islands surrounding Wrightsville Beach with our Epic Excursions guided paddleboarding tours. Our tours are special, as you will paddle through serene areas that are secluded and swarming with nature. An experienced guide will lead you through the calm waterways filled with a variety of wildlife, allowing you to fully immerse yourself into the natural habitat surrounding Wrightsville Beach.
